title: Alex's Biome Dimensions
description: Each biome got it's own dimension you can explore, farm wood in the forest dimension or go hunt for some loot in the Cursed or Deep Dark dimension!
body:
Join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/r8pw9NmfFH) for help

#


**Enter dimensions that are entirely themed around a specific biome, offering an ideal location for exploration and resource gathering. Whether you want to explore a desert dimension, a lush forest or even an icy tundra.** 

### Portalframe Block:
> Plains - Dirt
> 
> Forest - Oak Log
> 
> Desert - Sandstone
> 
> Snow - Blue Ice
> 
> Flower - Honey
> 
> Jungle - Jungle Wood Log
> 
> Aether - Glowstone
> 
> Lush Dimension - Flowering Azalea Leaves
> 
> Dark Forest - Dark Oak Log
> 
> Cherry Blossom - Cherry Blossom Log
> 
> Deep Dark - Sculk
> 
> Ocean - Prismarine
> 
> Cursed - Basalt
